rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sewing or knitting stitch, and it is also used when counting surgical stitches, as in 縫幾針.

example.english: The nurse says they can remove one stitch from my back tomorrow.
example.traditional: 姑娘話聽日可以拆我背脊嗰一針喇。
example.jyutping: gu1 noeng4 waa6 ting1 jat6 ho2 ji5 caak3 ngo5 bui3 zek3 go2 jat1 zam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the sharp pain in the side caused by running, other exercise, or sometimes laughing.

example.english: I got a stitch after two laps, so I had to stop and catch my breath.
example.traditional: 我跑咗兩個圈就岔氣，唯有停低抖吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 zo2 loeng5 go3 hyun1 zau6 caa3 hei3 wai4 jau5 ting4 dai1 dau2 haa5

rows.note: Use this for a particular stitch arrangement or technique in sewing or knitting, such as a cross-stitch method.

example.english: The stitch technique used for this cross-stitch piece is unusual, and it gives it a three-dimensional look.
example.traditional: 呢幅十字繡用嘅針法好特別，繡出嚟好有立體感。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 sap6 zi6 sau3 jung6 ge3 zam1 faat3 hou2 dak6 bit6 sau3 ceot1 lai4 hou2 jau5 lap6 tai2 gam2
